source: paper/PREREGISTRATION.md (amendment 1 in the preamble; amendments 2-6 as sections); lock commits from git with their UTC dates; CTO #532

amendments.change: the dependence among the six trace-feature ranking tests is quantified by permutation through the estimator, and all six correlations are reported whatever their outcome

fixes to what is measured: a verbalised confidence is required; every run has exactly three rounds; the agent choices are applied in a fixed precedence; the agent-count axis is dropped from the trainer grid; one set of evaluation genes is shared by the trainer sweep and the agents; the backbone-choice entropy is computed on the stated backbone over a fixed menu; the task draw is described as implemented; every prompt names the dataset and its modality, and the run starts on an empty, version-specific cache; the false-positive rate of the ranking criterion is bounded by permutation; the confidence entropy uses the direct simplex projection; the confidence-drop term is not clipped

the mitochondrial-read QC threshold is recorded, not applied; the Trainer role is a precedence tier; the Validator threshold is required (an unstated value is a schema failure); the stated grid size is the number of distinct (backbone, R) configurations, seven

provider changed to the Anthropic API with a pinned roster (Haiku 4.5 for four roles, Sonnet 5.5 for the Validator), structured outputs, per-role output ceilings with one retry at twice the ceiling, and rules for refusals and for the served model; spend lines of 12, 28 and 30 USD on the total, including the 1.3 USD carried in from the aborted run and the dry run; the single-family and same-family-judge caveats are stated in the methods
amendments.lock_note: the first commit is the lock and the other two correct its text, all before any data were collected
